title: The average price consumers are paying for smartphones is going back up - and you can thank Apple's $1,000 iPhone X (AAPL)
text: The average price consumers are paying for smartphones is going back up — and you can thank Apple's $1,000 iPhone X (AAPL) By Troy Wolverton Jan 25, 2018, 6:36 pm 28 pts Not too long ago, it looked like smartphones were quickly on their way to becoming inexpensive commodities.
